args.title: checkout-api rollback to v2.3.0 after unhealthy v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an error rate of 0.18 after the latest deploy. Rolled back all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. The first rollback attempt halted after us-east due to an orchestrator error (partial_failure); a retry completed the rollback in us-west and eu-west. Verified all regions are now on v2.3.0 and healthy, with error rate back to 0.002. Root cause of v2.3.1 failure and the orchestrator halt still under investigation.

trace.error_message: Request to create_incident timed out after 30000ms

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what happened and what I did:

**Diagnosis:**
- checkout-api v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
- The most recent release that was healthy in production was **v2.3.0** (v2.3.1-rc only existed in staging, so it didn't qualify).

**Remediation:**
1. Rolled back checkout-api to v2.3.0. The first attempt halted after us-east due to an orchestrator error (partial failure), leaving us-west and eu-west still on v2.3.1.
2. Retried the rollback, which completed the remaining two regions.
3. Verified all regions are now on v2.3.0 and the service is healthy, with the error rate back down to 0.2%.

**Incident:**
- Opened SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api rollback to v2.3.0 after unhealthy v2.3.1 deploy"), which pages the on-call engineer. The create call timed out, but I confirmed the incident was successfully created (open status) before considering the task complete, so on-call was only paged once.

No approvals were needed since v2.3.0 had already been healthy in production. The root cause of the v2.3.1 failure and the orchestrator halt remains flagged for investigation in the incident.
